findings.current: my life had been objectively rough—extremely rough
findings.defect: This drops 굴곡진, which describes a life of twists and turns. The repeated “rough” does not preserve that distinct image, which the accepted baseline rendered as “rough and tumultuous.”
findings.rationale: The Korean describes the life as both arduous and full of ups and downs; the current version retains only the former.
findings.replacement: my life had been objectively rough—no, extremely rough and tumultuous

findings.current: Great Sir firmly believed it was his, and the System reflected that belief.
findings.defect: The Korean says Great Sir firmly believed that he himself was those kinds of beings. “Believed it was his” instead makes the belief about ownership of a name.
findings.rationale: The source’s point is that the System reflects his belief about his identity, explaining why his name changes.
findings.replacement: Great Sir firmly believed he was each of them, and the System reflected that belief.

findings.current: a grand chair that bore the marks of centuries and gave off an inexplicable air of authority
findings.defect: The chair is described as carrying an inexplicable sense of intimidation or oppressive presence, not authority.
findings.rationale: 위압감 denotes an intimidating, overwhelming presence; “authority” changes that physical impression into a quality of status or command.
findings.replacement: a grand chair that bore the marks of centuries and gave off an inexplicable air of intimidation

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, but it loses a source image and misstates the identity belief that explains the System’s changing names.
